Bio Green Elixirs is an international health brand built around one idea: the best preventive science should not stay locked inside the country that developed it.

We are the international distributor of BIO N:OV, a 3rd-generation nitric oxide supplement manufactured in Korea by Bzzworld under GMP certification, and developed with a research board of eight Korean university professors.

From Singapore we ship worldwide, with fulfilment from Singapore and Korea.

settings.title: Science first
settings.body: Every claim on this site traces back to the manufacturer's documentation, a named laboratory, or a cited source. If we cannot source it, we do not say it.

settings.title: Certified manufacturing
settings.body: BIO N:OV is produced in Korea under GMP certification, using a patented fermentation process built on the proprietary microbial strain KACC91554P.

settings.title: Natural ingredients
settings.body: Fermented garlic extract, fermented lettuce extract, soybean and soybean sprouts. A short ingredient list you can read out loud.

settings.title: Global from day one
settings.body: Fulfilment from Singapore and Korea, multi-currency checkout, and free worldwide shipping over $99.

settings.text: Questions about the product, wholesale, or distribution in your market? Email info@biogreenelixirs.com and we will get back to you.
